snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage – Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Virtua Fighter has arrived on Nintendo Switch 2 — AVAILABLE NOW!

Bring the fight with you ANYWHERE as Virtua Fighter makes its Nintendo debut on the Switch 2! Master every bone-shattering strike, throw, and combo across multiple modes, including the all‑new single-player journey: "World Stage", all while expressing your style with hundreds of character customization options. Then step into the arena against players worldwide with Cross‑Play and Rollback Netcode support or sharpen your skills using newly enhanced Training and Replay tools designed for fighters of all levels.

Features:
All-new Single Player Mode: World Stage
Crossplay + Rollback Netcode support across all platforms
Improved Training tools and Replay Features

Official X (Twitter) https://x.com/vf_official

Official Website Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage | SEGA
